message: does this image show peritoneal carcinomatosis, metastatic tumor covering all of the abdominal viscera?
reply: Yes, this image is a classic example of peritoneal carcinomatosis. It shows widespread, nodular metastatic tumor growth covering the surfaces of the abdominal organs (viscera) and the lining of the abdominal cavity (peritoneum).
